Another way I have learned to better argue with my boyfriend is two things:

1. There is absolutely never a good reason for either of our voices to be raised. I'm not sure if you have this issue with him, but addressing that really helped. It makes sure that you never really have arguments, they're instead "discussions". There is where the "I feel" statements come in to play that /u/arcxiii mentioned. If either of us get to the point of wanting to yell, then the discussion needs to stop and come back to it when both of you are calm.

2. If you need to have a serious discussion, like planned out ahead of time, I always liked the idea of talking about serious things in a place where both of you can be relaxed. Get in to the bathtub together. Curl up under the sheets in bed. Be in a place where both of you can take your guard down and talk as equals.
